parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: spaceIdentifier
parameters.description: Project ID, equivalent to the projectId field, which is the UUID of the project.

parameters.name: workitemCategoryIdentifier
parameters.description: Work item category. Use "Req" for requirements, "Bug" for bugs, "Task" for jobs, and "Risk" for threats.

parameters.name: workitemTypeIdentifier
parameters.description: Work item sub-type ID, which can be retrieved from ListProjectWorkitemTypes (corresponding field: identifier). If not specified, the default pipeline is used.
